title: The shelf — recovered graduate theses on Bangkok shophouses and historic conservation areas

pointer.label: Perplexity Computer thread (commission pointer, not a citable authority)

note: Perplexity claimed 55 theses plus 3 open-access papers. The thread is Cloudflare-gated from this sandbox, so the list below is recovered from named authors and university repositories — not scraped from the thread, and not padded with invented titles. Entries marked notFullyVerified have sparse repository metadata (missing author, year, or both). Access is Direct PDF when the URL is a verified file, or Repository when it is a landing page.
